mentions.name: butterflyz
mentions.description: A Bluesky client that uses on-device AI to organize and summarize the contents of your feeds, so you can find interesting posts faster. Users can choose among dozens of AI models, and the client emphasizes usable screen space on small-screen devices.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a Bluesky client that uses on-device AI to organize and summarize the contents of your feeds, so you can find the interesting posts faster. You can choose among dozens of models.
mentions.author: Zigurd
